en.online_base_url_help: Base URL of the PSDK Online Server (e.g. http://50.21.190.201:3000). No trailing slash.
en.online_api_key_help: Required on nearly every request as the x-api-key header.
en.online_admin_key_warning: Sensitive. Required for admin routes (create / delete / purge gifts, maintenance, telemetry). Stored in plaintext localStorage on this machine — keep it off shared computers.
en.online_player_id_help: Used as x-player-id when listing claimable gifts as a player. Optional.
en.online_test_help: Calls /health without auth headers. If this fails, the URL is unreachable or wrong.
en.online_admin_not_configured_hint: Set the server base URL and admin key in Online settings before creating gifts.
en.online_gift_cancel_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
en.online_disabled_gifts_hint: Soft-deleted on the server. Use 'Enable' to bring a gift back online.
en.online_gifts_endpoint_missing: The server doesn't have the admin list endpoint yet. The maintainer needs to deploy mysteryGift.routes.ts (GET /api/v1/mystery-gift/admin). Once the server is restarted, refresh this page.
en.online_gift_delete_dialog_body: Disabling the gift removes it from the active list. Players will no longer see or claim it. You can re-enable it later from the Disabled list.
en.online_gift_code_help: Stored uppercase. Players claim it case-insensitively.
en.online_gift_allowed_claimers_help: Comma-separated player IDs. Leave empty to allow any player.
en.online_gift_error_title_long: Title must be 64 characters or fewer.
en.online_gift_error_code_required: Code is required for code-type gifts.
en.online_gift_error_empty_payload: Add at least one item, creature, or egg.
en.online_gift_error_date_range: Provide both 'valid from' and 'valid to', or enable Always available.
en.online_gift_error_date_order: 'Valid to' must be strictly after 'valid from'.
en.online_active_gifts_empty: No active mystery gifts on the server.
en.online_active_gifts_hint: Live admin view: every active gift on the server, including code-type gifts.
